content: The frog does not drink up the entire pond in which it makes its home.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: Even the humblest amphibian has the instinctual wisdom not to consume the very water that gives it life and shelter. Human civilization, however, frequently drains aquifers, clear-cuts ancient forests, and burns through communal reserves in a frenzy of greed. Moderate your appetite.
practicalInsight: Take only what you need today. Practice conscious restraint in your consumption and energy use.
reflectionPrompt: Are your personal or professional habits draining the very pond that sustains your peace and relationships?
